definitions: A technique in machine learning that involves creating new training data from existing data by applying various transformations (such as rotation, flipping, scaling, or cropping) to the original images. This helps to increase the diversity of the training set and improve the robustness of models, especially in computer vision tasks.
examples: Image Augmentation is crucial for training robust deep learning models.
The project utilized Image Augmentation to prevent overfitting.
Different Image Augmentation techniques were explored.
